page.overview:
What is Prosperous?

The Prosperous was a Providence-class Dreadnought manufactured in the factories on the planet Pammant by the Quarren builders of the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps. The dreadnought served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.

In 19 BBY, the Prosperous participated in an unprecedented assault on Coruscant, However, during the destroyer's engagements with the Republic, the Prosperous was captured by a Republic boarding party from the Star Destroyer Impavid led by Jedi General Saesee Tiin.

The Prosperous was first mentioned in the current Star Wars canon in the "Secrets of Spaceflight" section of the fifty-eighth issue of De Agostini's Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon magazine, In the Star Wars Legends continuity, the Prosperous was introduced in the twenty-third episode of the Star Wars: Clone Wars animated series, which aired on March 26, 2005. It was then identified in the StarWars.com Databank entry for Saesee Tiin.
